# MGS Capital Limited

MGS Capital Limited is a Kenyan financial services company offering insurance and investment advisory services, including medical and general insurance, insurance premium financing, retirement plan advisory, pension consolidation, NSSF Tier II advisory, money market fund advisory, study abroad loans, trade finance, bid bonds, and fundraising support for lending companies. It is led by Lizzie Gitiche and operates from CPA Centre, Old Stanchart Building, 1st Floor, Kenya.

Tagline: Your fiduciary investment advisory partner.

Serving: individuals, families, professionals, students and sponsors, employers and HR teams, contractors, traders, and lending companies across Kenya.

## Insurance
- [Medical Insurance](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/medical-insurance): private health cover for individuals, families, and employers, placed with licensed insurers.
- [General Insurance](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/general-insurance): motor, property, business, liability, WIBA, marine, engineering, travel, and domestic covers.
- [Insurance Premium Financing](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/insurance-premium-financing): pay an annual premium in instalments while the cover stays active.

## Retirement
- [Retirement Plan Advisory](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/retirement-plan-advisory): individual pension plans, occupational and umbrella schemes, contributions, projections, and benefit planning.
- [Pension Consolidation](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/pension-consolidation): combine retirement savings held in several schemes into one clear view.
- [NSSF Tier 2](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/nssf-tier-2): employer guidance on Tier II, contracting out, and Retirement Benefits Authority approval.

## Investment
- [Money Market Fund Advisory](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/money-market-fund-advisory): choosing and using money market funds for short-term money.

## Education
- [Study Abroad Loans](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/study-abroad-loans): financing tuition, living costs, travel, visa, and student health cover for study overseas.

## Enterprise
- [Trade Finance Solution](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/trade-finance-solution): import financing, letters of credit, guarantees, invoice and LPO financing.
- [Bid Bonds](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/bid-bonds): tender security issued by a bank or insurer.
- [Fundraising for Lending Companies](https://www.mgscapital.co.ke/services/fundraising-for-lending-companies): capital raising advisory for microfinance, digital, and asset-finance lenders. Not an offer of securities.
